correctness.rationale: For each annulus, all highest-bit-zero placement subsets fail, while extra failures correspond to the position of the target between consecutive ordered lower subset sums. Binary carry yields the exact integer gap and normalized mass. At ratio Q>2 each fixed dyadic atom converges and the proposed total mass is one, implying total variation. At Q=2 reversed Bernoulli sums tend to uniform binary expansion and their CDFs converge uniformly, proving the weak continuous limit. The Fibonacci root equation supplies Q>2 and largest atom; averaging lower subset sums proves the exact mean. Replayed checker passed 845 finite assertions/comparisons. Finite tests do not prove the infinite conclusion.
